exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-07-18 to 2026-07-24): growthbook.io had 18,082 sessions and 12,702 users (+21.5% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 18,082 sessions (+21.5% WoW) | 12,702 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,314 clicks (-2.0% WoW) | 214,850 impressions (-10.5% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 9,352 GA4 sessions (+9.3% WoW) all-traffic | 1,759 GSC clicks (-2.5% WoW) organic | 11,628 GSC impressions (-9.7% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,384 GA4 sessions (+19.5% WoW) all-traffic | 106 GSC clicks (+9.3% WoW) organic | 5,564 GSC impressions (-13.2% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,508 GA4 sessions (-1.3% WoW) all-traffic | 992 GSC clicks (+4.6% WoW) organic | 94,045 GSC impressions (-16.3% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 10,733 GA4 sessions (+37.3% WoW) all-traffic | 468 GSC clicks (-11.2% WoW) organic | 195,638 GSC impressions (-3.2% WoW)
- All-other-pages GA4 up +37.3% while GSC organic clicks are down -11.2% — the AI-displacement pattern is strong here. Pricing shows the same: GA4 +19.5% vs GSC impressions -13.2%. Real demand is growing; Google organic is not the full story.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely**'s /field-notes hub surfaced 49 pages in our tracking — a sitemap addition of mostly pre-existing content, not all net-new this week. Standout new pieces: **"AI Experimentation"** (KD 52, Tier 1), **"Agentic AI Experimentation Benchmark"**, **"Intro to Experimentation Analytics"**, **"Experimentation Buyers Guide"**, and **"The Digital Experimentation Playbook"** — all evaluation-stage intercepts. Three product-roadmap pieces also appeared: **"Remote MCP Server"**, **"Test Smarter and Faster With Agentic Experimentation"**, and **"New AB Results Page"** — Optimizely is explicitly building content around AI-native experimentation workflows that overlap with GrowthBook's positioning.
- **Harness** published two Tier 1 feature-flag posts: **"A Step-by-Step Guide to Feature Flag Implementation in CI/CD"** and **"Feature Flag Security in Your CI/CD Pipeline"** — directly targeting GrowthBook's feature-flag audience.
- **PostHog** added **"How to Enable Log Alerts API Feature Flag Logs Alerting"** (Tier 1) plus a new SDK guidelines page — incremental but on-target for the developer audience.
- ⚠️ No new pages detected from **Statsig**, **LaunchDarkly**, **Unleash**, **Flagsmith**, or **Eppo** — likely a monitoring gap, not a content pause.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** (published 2026-05-18): 176 clicks this week — down from 189 last week but still strong. Position 8.9 holds.
- **/blog/unleash-alternatives** (published 2026-06-19): 54 clicks — up from 37 last week (+46%), new high. Position 7.0. Momentum is accelerating.
- **/blog/how-to-implement-feature-flags-at-scale** (published 2026-05-26): 33 clicks, 25,910 impressions, position 9.4 — high impression-to-click gap still present; answer-capsule treatment remains the lever.

- **Top-10 footprint: 191 keywords (+102 over 3 months)** — trajectory unchanged, holding the strongest reading yet.
